title: General fan safety note (illustrative)
content: If an electric fan has smoke, a burning smell, or overheating, stop using it and arrange qualified inspection. Do not open the appliance while connected to power. This is a project safety note, not a manufacturer manual.

title: General mixer grinder safety note (illustrative)
content: If a mixer grinder emits a burning smell, overheats, sparks, or has damaged wiring, stop using it and arrange qualified inspection. Do not open the appliance while connected to power. This is a project safety note, not a manufacturer manual.

title: Warranty verification checklist (illustrative)
content: Check the purchase invoice, warranty card, product model number, warranty start date, exclusions, and authorized service terms. Warranty status should be confirmed with the manufacturer or seller; this checklist does not establish that a specific product is covered.
